title: Staged rollback notification playbook and deprecation timeline for LTS releases
creator: Maya Chen
description: Purpose: produce a customer-facing playbook that covers staged rollback notifications, deprecation timelines, and targeted migration guidance for runtime-1.18 LTS. The playbook must be reusable for future LTS releases and integrate with Console banners, status page updates, email/SMS templates, and support runbooks. Scope includes: (1) formal rollback criteria and customer notice flows, (2) a deprecation timeline with machine-readable compatibility matrix, (3) templated comms for each customer tier (self-serve, paid, enterprise), and (4) verification checklist and SLAs for follow-up remediation. Out of scope: internal-only incident postmortems and build/release automation tasks owned by ENG (handled in ENG-14500).
deliverables: Release-note template (HTML + plain text) for runtime-1.18 LTS
Staged rollback notice templates: pre-rollback warning, imminent rollback alert, completed rollback confirmation
Deprecation timeline document (dates, affected APIs and behaviors)
Compatibility matrix CSV and one-page summary for Console
In-Console banner copy + link flow for affected customers
Status page blurb and scheduled maintenance blocks
Support runbook with triage flow and escalation contacts
Customer FAQ and migration checklist per tier
Automation script spec to generate notice lists from billing/usage export
acceptance_criteria: Templates validated by legal and security (security_review_required=true)
Templates approved by Support, Sales, and Solutions Engs
Console banner renders correctly for at least three account types (trial, paid, enterprise) in staging
A/B tested email subject lines show >= 10% open rate uplift vs current baseline in a 1k-customer pilot
Compatibility matrix published to Drive and integrated into release notes link in Console

risk_assessments: Risk: Broad rollback notice could trigger support surge. Mitigation: tiered messaging and priority routing for enterprise customers.
Risk: Confusion over 'rollback' vs 'revert' terminology. Mitigation: standardize on 'staged rollback' with a short explainer in every notice.
Risk: Inconsistent Console rendering across locales. Mitigation: include plain-text fallback and verify for top 6 locales during staging.
Risk: Automated mailing list generation may miss recently-closed trial accounts. Mitigation: include a query for 'used-in-last-30-days' in export spec.
customer_templates:
Pre-rollback warning (enterprise): Subject: Action required — upcoming staged rollback may affect inference latency
Body: We are planning a staged rollback of runtime-1.18 in your region on 2026-03-31 02:00 UTC to address a regression impacting long sequences. During the maintenance window some requests may see higher latency or transient errors. Recommended actions: pin to runtime-1.17 for production-critical routes, enable automatic retries for non-idempotent calls only after consulting Support. Your Solutions Engineer @se-team will receive an advance runbook. Contact support@redwood.ai with ticket priority P0 for immediate escalation.

Imminent rollback alert (self-serve): Subject: Service notice — temporary behavior change starting in 2 hours
Body: We will begin a staged rollback for a small percentage of requests to mitigate a model-serving regression. Most users will not be affected. If you are relying on predictable 50ms latency for inference, consider switching to the dedicated endpoint or pin the model version to runtime-1.17. Link: https://redwood.ai/alerts/r1.18-rollback

Rollback completed confirmation (all tiers): Subject: Rollback complete — runtime-1.18 returned to previous stable variant
Body: The staged rollback is complete. We have restored the stable serving variant for affected traffic and are continuing monitoring. If you observe anomalies, please reply to this message or open a support ticket with 'Rollback-Check' in the subject line.

Deprecation timeline blurb (release notes): Effective dates: 2026-04-30: runtime-1.16 deprecated; 2026-06-15: runtime-1.17 entered LTS maintenance-only; 2027-03-01: runtime-1.18 becomes unmaintained. Guidance: Customers on private deployments must schedule upgrades with Customer Success at least 6 weeks prior to any major deprecation windows.
In-console banner (short): Planned maintenance: staged rollback for runtime-1.18 on 2026-03-31 02:00 UTC. Click for details and recommended actions.

Status page sample: We will perform a staged rollback in region us-west-2 to correct a regression. Impact: transient increases in latency and potential 429s for short windows. Updates posted in this incident timeline and via email to admins.
